cases.name: video-plan-blocks-without-crew-casting
cases.notes: Anti-bespoking guard. A live video_plan run with NO crew-casting artifacts must fail closed with reason crew_casting_required and must NOT write a storyboard. This is the exact bypass an agent would take to skip $cinematic-technique-selector and hand-compose the storyboard; the skill must refuse it in code, not rely on operator discipline.
command: D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-eval-nocrew.XXXXXX); bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D" --run-id eval-nocrew --no-write-memory; RC=$?; echo "gate_exit=$RC"; test ! -f "$D/storyboard.json" && echo no_storyboard_written; exit $RC

cases.name: video-plan-blocks-when-crew-roster-skipped
cases.notes: The specific bespoking I committed: dismissing crew casting and treating the style artifacts (technique_selection/script_dna/look_lock) as sufficient. This run supplies ONLY those style artifacts -- NO crew_contract.json -- and video_plan must still block with crew_casting_required naming crew_contract.json missing, and write no storyboard. Encodes 'you may not skip or hand-pick the director/producer/scriptwriter; the phase_03_crew step must have run.'
command: D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-eval-noroster.XXXXXX); C=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-eval-crewpartial.XXXXXX); for f in technique_selection.json script_dna_selection.json look_lock.json; do cp ../scripts/fixtures/crew/$f "$C/$f"; done; bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --crew-dir "$C" --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D" --run-id eval-noroster --no-write-memory; RC=$?; test ! -f "$D/storyboard.json" && echo no_storyboard_written; exit $RC
